statements.statement: The FY27 preliminary budget will not be balanced and will rely on an override.
The town received its FY27 health insurance rate increase, though PEC negotiations could still change the effect.
Three labor contracts (DPW, fire, clerical union) and PEC health insurance terms are still being negotiated and will affect the final FY27 budget number.
The preliminary FY27 budget gap is looking to be over $3 million, pending confirmation of school numbers.
Preliminary FY25 free cash is looking very healthy, over $3 million, driven by school turnback and strong investment income.
The capital plan was conservatively budgeted assuming $1.8 million in free cash, though the actual figure looks substantially higher; the plan will not be revisited until final numbers are certified.
The IT budget is absorbing a large increase as MUNIS's ARPA subsidy ends, with total MUNIS cost now $108,000.
